llm.summary: This is an instruction-only skill for making responses shorter, with some style guidance that users should avoid applying where nuance or uncertainty matters.

dimensions.detail: The artifact coherently describes response compression, directness, and termination guidance; it contains no executable code, data access, credential handling, or unrelated capabilities.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The triggers are broad and the hedging-removal example can overstate certainty, but the skill also says to preserve safety warnings, clarifying questions, technical context, and factual uncertainty markers.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Only SKILL.md is present. Metadata links to an upstream plugin for a broader experience, but this artifact does not include install scripts, dependencies, binaries, hooks, or commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, network access, local file access, credentials, profile/session stores, or external service permissions are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, local indexing, account mutation, or delegated authority is shown.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want shorter, more direct answers. Avoid relying on it for tasks where uncertainty, detailed reasoning, safety warnings, or step-by-step teaching matter, and watch for cases where it may make tentative conclusions sound too certain.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Broad trigger terms such as tokens, efficiency, communication, and directness could activate the skill in ordinary requests, but that is visible in metadata and only changes response style.
[SQP-3] expected: Removing empty hedging is part of the stated compression purpose; the artifact partially constrains this by preserving factual uncertainty markers and safety-critical context.
[SQP-3] unexpected: The example that rewrites a tentative debugging hypothesis into a definitive cause is poor guidance and could reduce nuance, but it is not paired with code execution, data access, or hidden high-impact behavior.
